disclosure.title: Allow sending the first page?
disclosure.description: Page {{page}} will be sent to recognize text, translate it, and prepare a translated image.
disclosure.network: Internet is required. Processing does not happen entirely on this device.
disclosure.data: We send the image bytes, including visible text, MIME type, dimensions, languages and attempt identifiers. Recognized text is used for translation. The app does not add the filename, local path or account to the request; the image itself may contain personal data.
disclosure.operator: Operated by {{operator}} ({{contact}}), using Google Cloud services.
disclosure.regions: The gateway operates in {{gateway}}. OCR uses the US region {{ocr}}. Translation uses the {{translation}} endpoint without a guarantee of remaining in a specific region.
disclosure.retention: Image, OCR, translation and result pass only through server memory during the session. The app keeps the original and result on this device. We maintain sanitized operational logs and minimal security and idempotency receipts without images or text. The receipt key has an absolute seven-day validity. Physical cleanup depends on key expiry, receipt age and database availability; logs follow a separate policy.
disclosure.cancellation: Disconnecting does not confirm cancellation of an ongoing external call. If delivery fails, no content is recoverable from the server; a new processing run requires your decision and may consume the services again.
disclosure.newExecution: This starts a new execution for page {{page}}, with a new attempt and possible additional service costs. Content from an earlier execution cannot be recovered from the server.

acquisition.error: Result has not been saved yet
acquisition.recover: Your original is preserved. Checking a receipt does not recover content or repeat processing.
acquisition.readyDescription: The page and its original are available for offline reading.

volatileReceipt.STARTED: The latest receipt reports processing in progress. This does not confirm delivery to this device.
volatileReceipt.FINISHED: The server produced the result, but this does not confirm it was saved on this device. The content cannot be recovered from the server.
volatileReceipt.FAILED: The receipt confirms remote processing failed. This is not a ready result on this device.
volatileReceipt.UNKNOWN: The remote state could not be confirmed. Checking the receipt does not repeat processing.

batch.title: Translate chapter pages
batch.description: Pick the pages and they are sent one at a time. A failure on one page does not stop the others.
batch.disclosureDescription_one: {{count}} page will be sent, one at a time, to recognize text, translate and prepare a translated image.
batch.disclosureDescription_other: {{count}} pages will be sent, one at a time, to recognize text, translate and prepare a translated image.
batch.cost: Each page sent may use the services and be billed. Pages with an uncertain result are never resent automatically.

consent.leaves: The chosen pages leave this device, one at a time, to recognize the text and translate it. Internet is required.
consent.retention: The server keeps no images or text: they only pass through memory during the session. Original and result stay on this device.
consent.uncertain: If a response is uncertain, the page is not sent again on its own. You decide later.

row.failed: Failed. Only this page will be resent.
row.unknown: Uncertain response. Nothing is resent automatically.

batch.cancelDescription: The page being sent is left with an uncertain result and is not resent automatically. The next pages will not be sent.
batch.uncertainDescription: Check again with the server before deciding. Nothing is resent automatically.
batch.closeDescription: Closing now interrupts the page being sent, which is left with an uncertain result.
